_comment: Ethereum mainnet (1) currencies for SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Token addresses match script/price_pools/1.json. Mainnet publishes no WBTC/USD feed in oracle_feeds.json, so WBTC rides the BTC/USD feed; cbBTC has its own.
